title: New GIB Assembly Line
summary: Designed a proposed internal Gas-Insulated Busduct assembly line using the DMADV methodology.
challenge: Explore how an internal GIB assembly line could address capacity, space, and lead-time constraints.
approach: Applied Define, Measure, Analyze, Design, and Verify; examined facility layout, material flow, capacity, testing needs, and operational risks.
outcome: Project-reported improvements: lead time from 64 to 23 days (about 64%); production capacity from 4,500 to 7,250 units/year (about 61%).
learned: Engineering improvements must align layout, resources, capacity, quality, and execution constraints.
